Interface TimedEffect

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
TimedEffect.BonusPickCard, TimedEffect.BonusTurnFood
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface TimedEffect extends Serializable
Strategy describing the round-time effect of a TimedBuilding. Each concrete implementation activates a bonus in a specific game phase.
